NATIVE NATURE is the brand of Senthoor Products India, a value-added agri products manufacturer based in Kurinjipadi, Tamil Nadu.

Our focus begins with banana, cashew, cashew apple, seafood, groundnut, jackfruit and vetiver, alongside rice-based products. We explore how familiar ingredients can take useful new forms for everyday life.

For retailers, distributors and bulk buyers, the conversation starts with your product, preferred format and quantity.
